findings.observed_0_2_0: Windows forwarded native minimization. CPU, memory pressure and thermal fields used an internal contract without a Windows provider.
findings.resolution: Use local Win32 reads through a single validated Tauri capability and distinguish unauthenticated browser hints, verified context creation, and missing native signals.

findings.observed_0_2_0: The historical median increased from 31.88 ms to 48.87 ms in the external automation metric.
findings.resolution: Use mirrored three-version measurements and check math, encoding, WebAssembly, worker, renderer and driver boundaries with the same expression sequence. Keep the historical readings in the record.

findings.observed_0_2_0: Historical minimized private commit increased by 32.09 MiB. The host contribution fell while the helper contribution rose.
findings.resolution: Measure long cyclic operation and the mirrored comparison. Read back the optional WebView2 LOW target on real minimization and NORMAL on restoration. Attribute the observed process-tree difference to helper processes where counters support that conclusion.

findings.observed_0_2_0: The App shell and manager used Standard-specific state and identifiers. A non-resolving descriptor remained in loading until external cancellation.
findings.resolution: Introduce typed registration with lifecycle ownership, global clearing and an activation deadline. Exercise distinct state shapes with the real App shell and independent async failures.

findings.observed_0_2_0: An eligible secondary operation in Ultra Light did not start and stayed pending until its scope closed. Ultra Light disabled the optional drawing scheduler.
findings.resolution: Protect a foreground slot, bound queue and operation lifetime, provide explicit deferral and make simplified redraws demand-driven.

findings.observed_0_2_0: The application trust boundary is the local packaged WebView. The credential provider is Rust-only.
findings.resolution: Keep the only added native permission local and scoped to the fixed command. Repeat offline verification, credential deletion and publication audit. Retain visible transitive dependency warnings.

open_limits: Incremental basic-mode memory below 100 MB is not established in the measured Windows environment.
Reliable native temperature and GPU hardware capability were unavailable on the measured Windows provider.
The host/backend, runtime and test isolation evidence covers Windows x64. Other platforms have the scopes recorded in compatibility.md.
